newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.07 percent to close at 1.0746 per dollar on the commercial foreign exchange market on continued expectations of a decline in the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on June 12 at between 1.0730 and 1.0780 reais per dollar and traders have been expecting a 0.1 percent decline since Tuesday.
The real's fall was also caused by net dollar outflows, dealers said.
At 1645 local/1945 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $60 million deficit. On Tuesday, forex contracts posted a $122.7 million deficit.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0785 per greenback.
In the parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.133 per dollar, traders said.
